authorization: Owner told the orchestrator on 2026-11-22 to use the remaining PixelLab credits today; same-day exception to the retirement rule.
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, mannequin template, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 41) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames come back on 40 px canvases, centred on 32x32 without scaling). v3 only makes even frame counts, so idle keeps frames 0-2 of 4 and telegraph keeps frames 1-3 of 4; dropped frames are not shipped. All four facings are separate generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Ember diver, a small chibi sea-creature diver with a very large round head, a round dark brass diving helmet with one glowing orange-red round porthole window, a charcoal-grey wetsuit with glowing ember cracks, stubby fins on the feet, a coiled dark rubber air hose trailing from the back of the helmet, short arms holding a small glowing coal lantern in the RIGHT hand. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

idle.action_description: stands and sways gently as if buoyant, the lantern in the right hand swinging slightly, porthole glowing, air hose bobbing

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, sways gently, lantern swings slightly in the right hand on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: facing left, sways gently, lantern swings slightly in front
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, sways gently, air hose bobbing behind the helmet
direction_prompts.east: facing right, sways gently, lantern swings slightly in front

walk.action_description: waddles forward in heavy finned steps, lantern swinging in the right hand, air hose trailing and bobbing behind

direction_prompts.south: waddles toward the viewer in heavy finned steps, lantern swinging in the right hand on the viewer's left
direction_prompts.west: waddles to the left in heavy finned steps, lantern swinging in front, hose trailing to the right
direction_prompts.north: waddles away from the viewer seen from behind, air hose bobbing
direction_prompts.east: waddles to the right in heavy finned steps, lantern swinging in front, hose trailing to the left

telegraph.action_description: crouches and coils back, raising the glowing lantern high overhead with the right hand, porthole flaring bright orange, body tensed before a dive-lunge

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, crouches and lifts the glowing lantern high above the helmet with the right hand (viewer's left), porthole flaring
direction_prompts.west: facing left, crouches and lifts the glowing lantern high overhead, porthole flaring
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, crouches and lifts the lantern high overhead on the viewer's right, air hose swinging
direction_prompts.east: facing right, crouches and lifts the glowing lantern high overhead, porthole flaring

strike.action_description: lunges forward headfirst in a fast dive, swinging the glowing lantern down in an arc, then straightens back up

direction_prompts.south: facing the viewer, lunges toward the viewer swinging the lantern down in an arc, then straightens
direction_prompts.west: facing left, lunges left swinging the lantern down in an arc, then straightens
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, lunges away from the viewer swinging the lantern down, then straightens
direction_prompts.east: facing right, lunges right swinging the lantern down in an arc, then straightens

attempts.what: idle, walk, telegraph, strike v3 for south/west/north/east, 4 clips x 4 directions

the lantern hand follows the right hand in south/north, in west/east it sits in front
